_about: Scope decisions for .claude/skills/bollywood-actor-filmography/scripts/extract_wiki.py films. Not read by build_workbook.py. Keys are Title|Year exactly as the Wikipedia filmography table gives them.
_rerun_warning: The filmography table mis-links two titles to actor biographies: Swayamvar|1980 points at [[Moushmi Chatterjee]] and Ek Aur Ek Gyaarah|1981 at [[Vinod Khanna]]. extract_wiki.py has no way to reject a non-film target, so after any fresh `fetch` their entries in WORK/table.json and WORK/pages.json must be set to null again, or `films` will attach an actor biography to those rows as a film source.

Anari|1975.source_material: Remake of the 1964 Bengali film Ayananta.

notes.Samadhi|1950: Not listed in the Wikipedia filmography table, which gives four child-artist credits; added because the Shashi Kapoor article's career section names Samadhi (1950) among his child-artist films and the film article casts him as Pratap, the young brother of Ashok Kumar's Shekhar. The same article's early-life section says he worked in four Hindi films as a child actor, which conflicts; with Samadhi the count is five.
notes.Aag|1948: Played the young Kewal Khanna, the child version of Raj Kapoor's character, billed as Shashiraj. The infobox credits Ram Ganguly for music with Kamal Gangoli as assistant; only Ganguly is entered as composer.
notes.Awaara|1951: Played the young Raj, the child version of Raj Kapoor's character.
notes.Sangram|1950: Played the child version of Ashok Kumar's character.
notes.Jahan Pyar Mile|1969: The filmography table lists 1969; the film article, titled Jahan Pyar Miley, gives a release date of 30 October 1970 and calls it a 1970 film.
notes.Rootha Na Karo|1970: The film article's infobox gives 31 December 1969 while its opening sentence and the filmography table both call it a 1970 film; the year is kept as 1970 and the infobox date recorded here.
notes.Touhean|1989: The filmography table lists 1989; the film was completed in 1987 but held from release until 20 November 1992, and the article calls it a 1992 film.
notes.In Custody|1994: Released in Hindi and Urdu as Muhafiz. The infobox's first date, October 1993, is the Tokyo Film Festival premiere rather than a theatrical release; New York followed on 14 May 1994 and London on 3 June 1994. The film is conventionally dated 1993 and won its National Film Award Special Jury recognition for 1993.
notes.Swayamvar|1980: The filmography table links this title to the biography of Moushumi Chatterjee rather than to a film article, which is an error on Wikipedia's side.
notes.Ek Aur Ek Gyaarah|1981: The filmography table links this title to the biography of Vinod Khanna rather than to a film article, which is an error on Wikipedia's side. The 2003 David Dhawan film Ek Aur Ek Gyarah is a different film.
notes.Oonch Neech Beech|1989: The filmography table marks the release as delayed.
notes.Ghar Bazar|1998: The filmography table marks the release as delayed; the Shashi Kapoor article calls it the last film in which he appeared.
notes.Utsav|1984: Produced by Kapoor and shot simultaneously in Hindi and English, with the English version's post-production done in London.
notes.Suhaag|1979: The filmography table notes that Kapoor also sang the playback for "Main To Beghar Hoon".
